work_items.title: GET public/fleet (AllowAnonymous, fleet from X-Fleet-Slug/subdomain) + Fleet.PrimaryColorHex column + migration
work_items.goal: An AllowAnonymous branding endpoint returning the resolved fleet's public fields. TenantResolutionMiddleware resolves the fleet from X-Fleet-Slug header/subdomain for anonymous requests too (it is gated on IsAuthenticated only for the JWT branch, verified), so the EF global query filter auto-scopes the read and there is no cross-fleet leak. Adds a nullable PrimaryColorHex (#RRGGBB) column to Fleet + migration because Fleet has Name/Phone but no color column (verified).
acceptance_criteria: GET public/fleet is AllowAnonymous() with a Summary documenting why it is public (branding for the customer PWA before login). It relies on TenantResolutionMiddleware resolving the fleet from the X-Fleet-Slug header or subdomain on an anonymous request (verified: the middleware gates only its JWT-claim branch on IsAuthenticated; branches 2 and 3 run for anonymous requests and it is registered before UseAuthorization).

When currentTenant.FleetId is null (unknown/missing slug) the endpoint returns 404 via Send.NotFoundAsync (no unscoped query). Otherwise it projects the resolved fleet (AsNoTracking, query-filter-scoped) to { name, phone, primaryColorHex, currency, timeZone }.

Fleet gains a nullable string PrimaryColorHex (#RRGGBB). A migration AddFleetPrimaryColor is added with dotnet ef --output-dir Infrastructure/Migrations (CLAUDE.md). This migration is sequenced BEFORE A-rating's AddOrderRating so the model snapshot applies cleanly (the one hard Lane-A ordering constraint).
PublicFleet_KnownSlug_ReturnsBranding, PublicFleet_UnknownSlug_Returns404, PublicFleet_NoSlug_Returns404, and PublicFleet_FleetASlug_NeverReturnsFleetBData (tenant isolation) pass.

work_items.title: TrackingTokenService (HMAC mint/validate) + GET public/track/{code}?k= (AllowAnonymous) + create-order response tracking fields
work_items.goal: The logged-out SMS tracking link. A Common/Tracking/TrackingTokenService mints/validates Base64Url(HMACSHA256(key, orderId:exp)); GET public/track/{code}?k= is AllowAnonymous, resolves the fleet from the slug, validates the token plus the 'valid until 2h after completion' rule, and returns the reduced TrackOrderResponse. FleetHub is [Authorize] (verified) so the logged-out path cannot use SignalR; the client polls this endpoint. Mint must live somewhere now even though SMS is deferred to 05, so the customer create-order response is extended with trackingCode/trackingToken/trackingUrlPath for the E2E.
acceptance_criteria: TrackingTokenService (internal, InternalsVisibleTo the test project) mints token = Base64Url(HMACSHA256(Tracking:HmacKey, "{orderId}:{expUnixSeconds}")) and validates: the signature verifies against the configured key AND now < exp AND (if the order is Completed) now < CompletedAt + 2h. The '2h after completion' rule is a validation-time check (completion is unknown at mint), NOT a mint-time expiry. The key is bound via TrackingOptions from config (Tracking:HmacKey) and the raw token is never logged (rules/logging.md).

GET public/track/{code}?k= is AllowAnonymous(), resolves the fleet from the slug/subdomain via the middleware, loads the order by PublicCode within the fleet query-filter scope, confirms the token's embedded orderId matches the loaded order, and returns the existing TrackOrderResponse shape extended with priceType and a display price (no phone, no customer id).

A bad, missing, expired, or tampered token, or a token whose orderId does not match the code, returns 410 Tracking.LinkExpired via AddError(...) + Send.ErrorsAsync(410, ct); an unknown code within the resolved fleet returns 404 (no-leak); no resolvable slug returns 404.

The customer path of CreateOrderEndpoint mints a tracking token (exp = now + 24h) and the CreateOrderResponse gains trackingCode, trackingToken, and trackingUrlPath (/c/t/{code}?k={token}). The existing { order } envelope is preserved (these are additive sibling fields). Dispatcher create is unaffected.

Track_ValidToken_ReturnsReducedDto, Track_ExpiredToken_Returns410, Track_TamperedToken_Returns410, Track_CompletedOver2h_Returns410, Track_CompletedUnder2h_ReturnsDto, Track_FleetASlug_WithFleetBCode_Returns404 (tenant isolation), CreateOrder_Customer_ReturnsTrackingCodeAndToken, and TrackingTokenService_RoundTrips_MintThenValidate pass.

work_items.title: GET pricing/quote (CustomerOnly) returning a fixed price or an estimate RANGE
work_items.goal: A CustomerOnly quote endpoint that wraps IGeoProvider + the fleet default Tariff server-side and returns a fixed price (route match) or an estimate RANGE (tariff price plus/minus 10 percent, rounded to 10 CZK). Never a single exact estimate (AC #4). This wraps geo/route server-side so no customer-facing geo/route widening is needed (only geo/suggest, A-geo-suggest). Pre-06 contract documented for Lane B.
acceptance_criteria: GET pricing/quote is CustomerOnly and tenant-scoped. Coordinate query params are bound as string? and parsed with double.Parse(..., NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) exactly as RouteEndpoint does (the FastEndpoints double query-binding locale landmine, CLAUDE.md); the validator uses double.TryParse(InvariantCulture) to return a clean 400 for bad input.

When an enabled, non-deleted, valid-now PointToPoint Route exists whose from/to coords are within a small radius of the request, the response is { priceType: "Fixed", fixedPriceCzk } with that route's PriceCzk. Otherwise the endpoint calls IGeoProvider.RouteAsync, prices from the default Tariff as Max(MinimumFareCzk, round(BaseFareCzk + PerKmCzk*km)), and returns { priceType: "Estimate", estimateLowCzk, estimateHighCzk } where low/high = price minus/plus 10 percent rounded to 10 CZK. estimateLow is strictly less than estimateHigh — a single exact estimate is never returned (AC #4).

A missing dropoff returns an Estimate with a wide band derived from the tariff minimum. An OSRM/upstream failure returns 502 Geo.RouteUnavailable (reuse the existing code) via the try/catch + Send.ErrorsAsync(502) pattern from RouteEndpoint; no tenant resolved returns 400.

Quote_RouteMatch_ReturnsFixed, Quote_NoRoute_ReturnsEstimateRange_NeverExact, Quote_EstimateBand_IsTariffPricePlusMinus10RoundedTo10, Quote_NoDropoff_ReturnsWideEstimate, Quote_InvalidCoords_Returns400, Quote_CrossTenant_UsesCallerFleetTariffOnly (tenant isolation), and Quote_OsrmDown_Returns502 pass (FakeGeoProvider precedent).

work_items.title: Order rating columns + migration + POST orders/{id}/rating (CustomerOnly, once) + dispatcher order-detail display
work_items.goal: Customer rates a completed order once. Adds RatingStars/RatingComment/RatedAt to Order + migration; POST orders/{id}/rating is CustomerOnly, owner-only, Completed-only, once. The dispatcher order-detail (OrderDetailDto/GetOrderEndpoint) gains the three additive fields as a sub-task (AC #7), not a separate WI. Depends on A-public-fleet to serialize the TaxiDbContextModelSnapshot.cs regeneration (two migrations cannot be generated in parallel — the second would clobber the first's snapshot; the conductor serializes only via depends_on) and to serialize the ErrorCodes.cs append.
acceptance_criteria: Order gains RatingStars (int?), RatingComment (string?, max 500), RatedAt (DateTimeOffset?). A migration AddOrderRating is added with dotnet ef --output-dir Infrastructure/Migrations. This migration runs AFTER A-public-fleet's AddFleetPrimaryColor so the model snapshot rebases cleanly (the one hard Lane-A ordering constraint).

POST orders/{id}/rating is CustomerOnly and owner-only (CustomerUserId == sub, no-leak 404 otherwise). The order must be Completed (else 409 Order.NotCompleted) and not already rated (RatedAt == null, else 409 Order.AlreadyRated). On success it sets RatingStars, RatingComment, RatedAt = timeProvider.GetUtcNow(). The request DTO uses plain properties (NOT C# required) with a validator enforcing stars in 1..5 and comment length <= 500 (the required-STJ-trap from CLAUDE.md).
The dispatcher order-detail OrderDetailDto and GetOrderEndpoint projection gain additive ratingStars/ratingComment/ratedAt fields (AC #7); existing fields and callers are unchanged.

Rate_CompletedOwnOrder_StoresRating, Rate_Twice_Returns409AlreadyRated, Rate_NotCompleted_Returns409, Rate_NotOwner_Returns404, Rate_StarsOutOfRange_Returns400, Rate_CrossTenant_Returns404 (tenant isolation), and DispatcherOrderDetail_AfterRating_IncludesStars (AC #7) pass.

work_items.title: GET routes/common?validNow= (CustomerOnly, tenant-safe, valid-now filter on the existing Route entity)
work_items.goal: The Home common-route cards. A CustomerOnly, tenant-scoped read that filters the existing Route entity by valid-now (Europe/Prague time/day). Built from existing Route data (Name/Type/PriceCzk/ValidDays bitmask/ValidFromTime/ValidToTime/IsEnabled/DeletedAt, verified) — not a stub. Sole owner of the Routes test area; does NOT touch ErrorCodes.cs (no new error codes), so it is fully parallel-safe.
acceptance_criteria: GET routes/common?validNow=true is CustomerOnly, tenant-scoped, AsNoTracking. It returns enabled (IsEnabled), non-soft-deleted (DeletedAt == null) routes whose ValidDays bit matches the current Europe/Prague weekday AND whose ValidFromTime..ValidToTime window (null = all-day) contains the current Europe/Prague time, projected to { id, name, type, priceCzk } ordered by Priority descending. Valid-now is computed by converting timeProvider.GetUtcNow() to Europe/Prague (CLAUDE.md time conventions).
The listing is tenant-safe via the query filter; another fleet's routes never appear.
CommonRoutes_ReturnsOnlyValidNowEnabled, CommonRoutes_OutOfWindow_Excluded, CommonRoutes_Deleted_Excluded, and CommonRoutes_CrossTenant_ReturnsOwnFleetOnly (tenant isolation) pass.

A validator bounds page/pageSize.

Both endpoints are own-rows via CustomerUserId and tenant-safe via the query filter; another customer's or another fleet's rows never appear. Both endpoints' test classes live in namespace Taxi.Api.Tests.Orders.Mine so the filter FullyQualifiedName~Taxi.Api.Tests.Orders.Mine runs every named test.

MyActiveOrder_ReturnsNonTerminal, MyActiveOrder_NoneActive_Returns204, MyActiveOrder_OtherCustomer_NotReturned, MyOrders_ListsOwnOrdersPaged, MyOrders_OtherCustomer_NotReturned, and MyOrders_CrossTenant_ReturnsOwnFleetOnly (tenant isolation for both endpoints) pass.

work_items.title: Tracking /c/t/:code (two modes: SignalR authed / public-track poll logged-out) + cancel + push prompt
work_items.goal: Large human status headline per state; car marker + pickup pin. Authed customer -> the single /hubs/fleet Subscribe(orderId) (live headline + marker, cache-patch, stale-event guard). Logged-out link -> GET public/track poll every 10 s (FleetHub is [Authorize], verified). Collapsed details; 'Zrusit objednavku' (New/Assigned/Accepted, confirm dialog, post-Accepted hint) -> POST orders/{id}/cancel with reason text + JWT; push-subscription prompt after first order (client permission only).
acceptance_criteria: trackingMode.ts (pure) selects authed-vs-public from stored customer-token presence. Authed mode reuses the existing /hubs/fleet module-level singleton in useFleetHub.ts (NEVER a second connection), calls Subscribe(orderId), patches the ['orders','track',id]/detail cache in place on OrderChanged with a version stale-event guard (drops version <= cached), and moves the marker on DriverPositionChanged (AC #2). Public mode (logged-out /c/t/:code?k=) polls getPublicTrack every 10 s (FleetHub is [Authorize] so SignalR is unavailable logged-out) - no second connection, no auth.

statusHeadline.ts (pure) maps status -> one-line Czech headline: New 'Hledame ridice...', Assigned/Accepted 'Ridic {name} prijede za ~{eta} min' (eta omitted when the track DTO EtaMinutes is null, pre-06), Arrived 'Ridic je na miste' + plate/color, InProgress 'Jedete', Completed 'Hotovo - {price} Kc' + rating trigger, Cancelled customer-friendly reason + Zavolat.

getPublicTrack and cancelOrder are added to client.ts. 'Zrusit objednavku' is shown only in New/Assigned/Accepted via a confirm dialog with at most two buttons that traps focus and closes on Escape (rules/web-accessibility.md#keyboard-focus); after Accepted it shows the hint 'Ridic uz jede, prosime zruste jen v nutnem pripade'. Cancel POSTs orders/{id}/cancel with { reason: <czech text> } and the customer JWT (the server records CancelledByRole=Customer).

An expired public token (410 Tracking.LinkExpired) shows 'Odkaz vyprsel' + the call button (AC #3); a cancel 409 shows 'Objednavku uz nelze zrusit'; SignalR down in authed mode falls back to the last cache + offline banner, never a blank screen (rules/web-realtime.md#last-known-state). TrackingMap (Leaflet) is React.lazy. The push-subscription prompt (permission only, no server push) appears after the first order.

AC #8 parity green; statusHeadline.test.ts (each status -> headline; Cancelled shows reason+call; Completed shows price+rating), trackingMode.test.ts (token present -> authed/SignalR; absent -> public/poll), useTrackingPublic.test.ts (fake timers: 10 s poll; 410 -> expired state), a component axe assertion, and locales.parity.test.ts pass.
